label: Houseplants
description: Named indoor foliage plants, trailing plants, ferns, succulents, cacti, flowering houseplants and bonsai.
notes: Indoor plant identities and recognizable specimen forms belong here, including named succulents, cacti and bonsai types. plant.flower holds blossoms as the main subject and plant.tree holds outdoor whole-tree forms. Values are singular common or botanical names with articles included; plants are not assigned a pot, room or decor style. Kind chips overlap for trailing succulents and flowering specimens, and bonsai entries name the species as well as the trained form.
